'''Blanked:''' The Players Committee's Competitive Balance Team blanked this card on 26 April 2011, effective immediately (repeated on the rules forum on 27 April 2011), saying it would likely be re-released in a new form. A blanked card is treated as if it did not exist from that date (in effect a ban); it is not a new version. It stays in its set and is legal in period formats that end before the blanking.
